reason: A is the better proposal because modifying BCC dislocation-core mobility with dilute V is physically plausible and directly testable across all three required regimes, although its irradiation-retention claim is weakly supported. B improperly extrapolates FCC/HCP TWIP–TRIP behavior to stable BCC NbMoTaW and overlooks the strong likelihood of carbon forming embrittling carbides with Nb, Ta, Mo, and W.
